linkedin.hook: Formal verification in Blend v2 solves pool math. Execution latency dictates actual farmer solvency.
linkedin.copy:
Blend v2 formal verification gives Soroban developers mathematical certainty around b-token exchange rates and pool invariants. However, deploying capital across pooled lending markets still exposes farmers to systemic execution bottlenecks during high volatility. Theoretical pool safety degrades when automated strategies fail to rebalance collateral before liquidation engines trigger.

Composability on Soroban demands deterministic risk isolation. Wrapping Blend v2 b-tokens directly inside Vanna SmartAccounts isolates individual farmer debt from shared pool contagion. State reads synchronize via ~320ms Mercury indexer latency, allowing programmatic rebalancing down to a strict 1.10x Health Factor floor before liquidators extract value.

Execution costs remain deterministic at 0.00014 XLM fixed gas per invocation, eliminating the execution variance typical of EVM money markets. Builders can inspect contract bindings and simulate leveraged farming loops directly on testnet. Deploy your testnet SmartAccount sandbox at test.stellar.vanna.finance.

Institutional architecture is documented at test.stellar.vanna.finance

reddit.hook: Dissecting Blend v2 b-tokens and Vanna SmartAccounts for leveraged Soroban farming
reddit.copy:
Blend released formal verification for their v2 pool architecture, standardizing b-token yield dynamics on Soroban. The pool invariant proofs prevent reentrancy and rounding exploits at the base liquidity layer, which gives us a solid foundation for automated yield farming.

The friction point for farmers has always been debt automation. Looping b-tokens manually requires multiple transactions, balance checks, and exposure to liquidation penalties if an indexer falls behind. We built Vanna SmartAccounts to sit between the user and Blend v2.

A SmartAccount acts as an isolated contract proxy. Instead of depositing raw collateral and taking debt against your primary wallet, the SmartAccount deposits to Blend, receives b-tokens, and evaluates risk locally. Position safety relies on a hardcoded 1.10x Health Factor floor. Our relayer pipeline processes oracle feeds and state transitions via Mercury indexer at roughly ~320ms latency. Because Soroban execution costs sit around 0.00014 XLM fixed gas, you can automate leverage loops and deleverage steps without eating into yield margins.

To test this setup yourself, set your wallet to Futurenet/Testnet and initialize an isolated account. You can mock Blend v2 supply positions, mint test assets, and monitor how the contract enforces the 1.10x floor under simulated volatility.

Deploy your testnet SmartAccount sandbox at test.stellar.vanna.finance.

Disclosure: I am a core contributor to Vanna Protocol.
